<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that manually drafting/sending claim progress messages remains an open problem. I checked the five most similar items: 'Policyholder milestone notifications' (Notion) addresses automatic policyholder notifications at milestones, not the drafting/sending of progress messages by handlers, and shows no shipped status; 'Claim information display' (story 4135) is started but not completed and covers a claims overview screen, not messaging; 'Claims timeline', 'Supplier directory', and 'Bulk upload documents' (completed 2026-10-06) address unrelated problems. No completed story or roadmap item solves the same core problem of manual, error-prone drafting and sending of progress messages.", "verdict": "pass"}
